contract.objective: Independently audit and close remaining cross-harness gaps in Chohogi document ownership, feedback circulation, derived-state provenance, and verification confidence while preserving existing worktree changes.
requested: three separate reviews of document/registry flow, feedback circulation, and source-to-consumer evidence
cross-challenge of review findings before repair choices
repair only confirmed gaps and verify affected consumers and installation boundaries
excluded: model-selection policy and user model choices
automatic semantic deduplication of all project documents
claiming that static tests prove runtime behavior or future model adherence
discarding, restoring, or rewriting unrelated pre-existing worktree changes
raw prompts, private reasoning, credentials, or private user-project data

requestedItems.description: Verify one active execution owner and document-registry coverage for Chohogi's actual document layout.
Trace feedback discovery through explicit response and active-plan update, including relevant record synthesis.
Verify derived status, health, completion, and consumer claims cannot outrank source evidence.
Obtain three independent first-pass reviews and cross-challenge their material findings.
Run relevant behavioral/static checks and source-to-install verification, reporting unobservable runtime limits.

acceptance.description: Pre-existing modifications are preserved, and one active plan owner scopes audit, repair, and verification.
Each review names concrete paths, call paths, reproduction or counterevidence, and confidence; disagreements remain explicit.
Every persistent repair maps to confirmed evidence and its owning source, consumer, fixture, and verifier; unsupported optional work is excluded.
Changed active contracts are verified against the declared source and isolated-install tool consumers; unavailable interactive host runtime behavior is explicitly deferred.

consumerEvidence.consumer: source CLI and isolated installation layout
interactive Codex/Claude host session consuming the installed assets
consumerEvidence.reason: This checkout can verify source and isolated install parity, but cannot observe a fresh Codex or Claude host session consuming the installed guidance.

acceptance.description: All requested items are implemented, deferred, or excluded with reasons; final claims stay within observed evidence.

verification: relevant execution-record, replay, manifest and install tests
